[b]THEP stance on the Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/b]
After much debate, the THEP council has come to the decision that action must be taken against the Technokratisches Kaiserreich (TK) in response to their unprovoked aggression against the Sikirskian people and their illegal occupation of the Nestor-Sikirsk territory. Sanctions are to be placed upon the TK by all THEP members and non-members are encouraged to follow. 

These sanctions include banning all trade with the TK, intercepting, searching and potentially seizing any and all ships bound to, or from the TK that enter a nations territorial waters, freezing all TK assets within a country and the banning of all travel to or from the TK (TK citizens within a nations borders at the time of this event will be allowed to safely return).

Additionally, Hydronia has put a TK-only blockade of its section of the eastern strait in place, hoping to damage the TKs trade.

[b]Italian-Dutch unsuspended[/b]
After the Italian-Dutch civil war came to a quick end with the socialist movement winning, the nation has been unsuspended from all THEP organisations and once again has a voice in the alliances affairs, now under a transitional socialist government.
